definitions.explanation: A state of being relaxed or free from difficulty.

examples.english: To become easier; to feel relieved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がって→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧{楽|らく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I felt relief when my fever went down.
I want to take it easy.

examples.japanese: {楽|らく}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: To sit in a comfortable posture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧{楽|らく}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm relieved the pain is gone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{返|かえ}して→返す：09648_kaesu⟧{楽|らく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I felt relieved after paying off my debt.

notes:
{楽|らく} functions as both a noun and a na-adjective, covering physical comfort, mental ease, and freedom from difficulty.

AS NA-ADJECTIVE:
- {楽|らく}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: an easy job
- {楽|らく}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: a comfortable posture
- {楽|らく}な⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: comfortable shoes

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {楽|らく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take it easy, take the easy way
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{楽|らく}: feeling at ease, relieved
- {楽|らく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to feel better, become easier
- {楽|らく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think positively, not stress

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧: easy (in terms of difficulty)
- {楽|らく}: easy (in terms of effort/comfort)
- ⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧: comfortable (environment, conditions)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{楽観|らっかん}→楽観：17126_rakkan⟧: optimism
- ⟦{気楽|きらく}→気楽：07159_kiraku⟧: carefree
- ⟦{安楽|あんらく}→安楽：18657_anraku⟧: comfort, ease
